name: T. A. Matthews
role: Stock inspector, later at Glendive; sheriff candidate 1886
bio: T. A. (Tom) Matthews represented the Little Missouri ranges on the round-up committee of the Eastern Montana Live Stock Association in March 1884 and by May held a position as stock inspector, stationed at Mandan. The paper variously calls him inspector for the eastern Montana association, the Wyoming Stock Association, Dakota and eastern Montana, and the Montana Stock Growers' Association; by January 1885 he had also been appointed a Deputy United States Marshal for Montana and helped arrest Sullivan at Miles City. In 1885 he was appointed an inspector by the Montana board of stock commissioners and was reported stationed at Horse Plains as Deputy Territorial Veterinarian. By 1886 he was stock inspector at Glendive, filled in as inspector at the Medora slaughter-house that July, and in September received the Democratic nomination for sheriff of Dawson County, Montana.
